title: Can Claude replace Expensify? 24/24 checks, 9 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built an Expensify alternative, an expense report tool with receipts, flags, one approval and a finance queue, from one written spec: all 24 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 9 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:35): https://youtu.be/hSGupyVy3ak
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/expense-reports
Expensify pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/expensify

Expensify's Submit plan is free for all members; Collect, with reimbursements and approvals, is $5 per member per month (expensify.com/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
